shared_elements: repeated parallel strokes forming a fan/comb-like band
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures and both include a rectangular enclosed panel and a set of closely spaced parallel strokes (crew strokes on a hull in A, a fan- or feather-like fringe in B), but these are generic correspondences at best. A is a dense, multi-figure schematic linear composition of stick-like people and long crewed boats stacked in registers, whereas B is a single modelled relief scene with a rounded, naturalistic profile head and a figure standing within a frame, sharing no specific posture, attribute or arrangement with A.
